name: Amex EveryDay® Preferred Credit Card

apr.notes: APR for Purchases: Prime Rate + 12.74% to Prime Rate + 21.74% (variable). APR for Cash Advances: Prime Rate + 21.99% (variable). Specific numeric APR not computed as Prime Rate value not stated on page.

fx_fee.notes: 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 Membership Rewards point per $1 on all other eligible purchases. 50% extra points when you make 30 or more purchases in a billing period.

rewards.redemption_notes: 50% extra Membership Rewards points on purchases when 30 or more separate purchases are made in a billing period.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 15,000 Membership Rewards points after you make eligible purchases totaling $2,000 or more within your first 6 months of Card Membership.

benefits.title: 50% Extra Points Benefit
benefits.description: If you make 30 or more separate purchases of goods or services in a billing period with your Amex EveryDay Preferred Credit Card, you earn 50% extra Membership Rewards points on those purchases less returns and credits with a date in that billing period.

notes: Key facts (annual fee, APR formula, FX fee, signup bonus, 50% extra points) verified from official Amex cardmember agreement and terms page. Earn categories (3X U.S. supermarkets up to $6,000/year then 1X, 2X U.S. gas stations, 1X all other) confirmed from the official product page metadata.
